intent.description: Search Google Flights for one-way, round-trip, or multi-city flight options with filters.
intent.userSaid: searched for a round trip flight; searched for a one way flight; played with the stops and the airlines filters; added bags; played with the price and time filters; played with the duration filter

parameters.name: trip_type
parameters.description: Ticket type such as round_trip, one_way, or multi_city.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Origin airport code, city code, or place identifier for one-way and round-trip searches.

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: Destination airport code, city code, or place identifier for one-way and round-trip searches.

parameters.name: return_date
parameters.description: Return date in YYYY-MM-DD format for round-trip searches.

parameters.name: itinerary
parameters.description: Multi-city itinerary as semicolon-separated origin,destination,date legs, such as SFO,LAX,2026-09-01;LAX,JFK,2026-09-04. Supplying this value selects multi-city search semantics.

parameters.name: selection_token
parameters.description: Selection token from a prior search_flights result. For staged round-trip or multi-city selection, pass this with selected_flights to fetch the next leg options.

parameters.name: selected_flights
parameters.description: JSON array of already selected leg tuples from a prior search_flights result. For staged round-trip or multi-city selection, pass this with selection_token to fetch the next leg options and emit a complete selected_flights array.

parameters.name: stops
parameters.description: Stops filter for routes with both nonstop and connecting options, such as any, nonstop_only, one_stop_or_fewer, or two_stops_or_fewer.

parameters.name: airlines
parameters.description: Comma-separated airline or alliance codes to include, such as AS, AA, WN, ONEWORLD, SKYTEAM, or STAR_ALLIANCE.

parameters.name: bags
parameters.description: Number of bags to include in fare filtering.

parameters.name: outbound_time_range
parameters.description: Outbound departure or arrival time constraints encoded as start and end hours, such as 2-21.
